papers.title: Post-Training in Time Series Foundation Models: A Unifying Framework
papers.what: Organizes the methods that sit between a pretrained time series foundation model and its deployment into five families keyed by where they act in the prediction pipeline: parameter adaptation, context augmentation, model composition, output processing with uncertainty control, and compression with specialization.

papers.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
papers.what: Trains a language model through self-play using agent skills as the unit of practice, with a proposer, a solver, and a skill controller that co-evolve in a reinforcement learning loop so the task distribution grows with the model.

papers.title: Scaling Native Multimodal Pre-Training From Scratch
papers.what: Measures scaling laws for a vision-language model trained from scratch on mixed image and text, showing language and multimodal objectives follow different allocation rules and deriving an efficiency frontier over model size, token count, and data mixture.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (PHB9VRVM); Flamingo (SC8KWYVK)

papers.title: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
papers.what: Reframes agent memory from store-and-retrieve into a lifecycle with five primitives, and argues with a cost model that only validated compaction keeps token cost linear in conversation length without an accuracy cliff (92% LongMemEval, 93.2% LoCoMo).
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (BDY3HUCV); Agent AI Survey (Z9WZPMNU)
